status: locked before data fitting; source metadata inspected only

dataset.name: PAMAP2 Physical Activity Monitoring
dataset.license: UCI declares CC BY 4.0; retain archive notices and attribution
dataset.sessions: Protocol only; Optional excluded before inspection
dataset.missing_subject_rule: Report absent/short/zero-eligible participants; never replace after outcomes. Test is exploratory with two participants.

task.target: Arithmetic mean of five observed 1-second HR-bin means in (origin+horizon-5, origin+horizon]. All five bins must have actual finite positive observations; no target interpolation.
task.inputs: Actual recorded HR and optional wrist 16g acceleration only at timestamps <= origin. Exclude activity IDs, chest/ankle IMUs, demographics, future observations and session summaries.
task.one_second_bins: Right closed (end-1,end]; computed from actual samples; no interpolation or forward fill. Nonfinite and nonpositive HR are missing.
task.input_eligibility: At least54/60 observed HR bins; latest actual HR age <=2s; no gap >4s including history edges. Negative/nonmonotonic/duplicate timestamps invalidate the source session rather than silently reorder it.
task.wrist_eligibility: Optional wrist model needs >=90% finite acceleration triads of expected100Hz samples in past10s. HR-only model remains separately reportable.
task.abstention: Reject ineligible input before target lookup. Keep target-missing separate from input abstention. Report every planned origin, input-eligible count, target-observed count, scored count and their denominators. No residual-based rejection.

models.persistence: Latest actual valid HR available at origin, held constant for each horizon.
models.ridge_target: Future target HR minus latest_hr; add latest_hr back after regression.
models.normalization: Fit feature mean/SD on training participants only; zero-SD features scale1. No per-test-person centering. Standardized ridge with intercept.
models.selection: For each horizon choose among persistence and six ridge variants by validation participant-macro MAE on common wrist-eligible observed-target origins. Tie within1e-9: persistence, HR-only, HR+wrist, then larger alpha. Retain all prespecified candidates for transparent results; selected primary remains fixed before test scoring.
models.training_weight: Each training participant has equal total fit weight, so long sessions do not dominate.
models.empty_common_validation: If no common validation opportunities, omit wrist variants and select persistence/HR-only on common HR-eligible validation origins; explicitly report this fallback. No test selection.

secondary_adaptation.status: Separate from frozen primary, fixed before test
secondary_adaptation.model: Selected frozen model plus per-participant per-horizon bias. Initial bias0; once each target matures, update bias=clip(0.95*bias+0.05*(observed_target-frozen_prediction),-10,10).
secondary_adaptation.ordering: At an origin, issue prediction using bias from previously matured labels only. Process current-time mature labels after issuing current-origin prediction. Each prediction outcome updates once; no label/target lookup may affect earlier predictions. Reset bias per participant; do not tune on test.
secondary_adaptation.report: Score before update, report frozen vs adaptive on same delivered origins, cold-start first10 matured outcomes separately, and full chronological traces. A losing adapter remains a reported negative result.

metrics.primary: Participant-macro MAE in bpm at each horizon; paired per-participant delta versus persistence.
secondary: pooled window MAE explicitly labeled dependent windows
actual wall/CPU time and peak RSS
metrics.uncertainty: No window-wise confidence intervals or significance claims. With two held-out people report both outcomes; no population precision claim or calibrated prediction band.
metrics.success: A reproducible completed benchmark is success; lower error is a hypothesis. Report persistence winning and any zero-coverage participant.

claim_limits: No Apple Watch transfer or real-device validation
No app integration or personalized model deployment
